items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: I want to make this picture with Machito because Machito play the real thing.

ctx.x: Because she was a white girl.

She was a white girl and we was a black band. So she say: 'I don't care if they don't show this picture in Georgia or whatever, I want to make this picture with Machito because Machito play the real thing. If I can't make it with Machito, forget it'., and they were very impressed because she was blond, good voice, good personality, good singer and they thought that it could -- there was a team a dance team that it was dancing mambo, you know, those exhibition things......
